parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing restriction exists: trans presentation is lawful, foreign documents are accepted (the X-marker decree even covers non-citizens), hospital placement follows affirmed gender, and the penal code carries life imprisonment for gender-motivated killing. Courts work for trans people — the 2025 care ban was struck down — and there is no documented targeting of visitors, facility bans, or police profiling. These sit at reduced risk (0.65–0.75 tier). Deductions: the country is in documented deterioration — a record 2025 hate-crime year (aggregate, undenominated), activists describing chaotic vulnerability, the anti-discrimination agency abolished, the hate-crime aggravator judicially hollowed, an unresolved prison-housing decree, and hostility reported in conservative provinces with no national discrimination statute. These weaken recourse and signal rising violence without constituting universal exposure or organised targeting. Net: reduced risk, toward the middle of the band.
